name: Mitch
title: Striking Coach
bio: Mitchell Reed is a Kickboxer & Muay Thai fighter at Harbinger with a deep competitive resume. He coaches Kickboxing/Muay Thai Fundamentals & Advanced classes, bringing a well-rounded approach to striking that draws from Muay Thai, Boxing, Dutch Kickboxing, and traditional Kyokushin Karate. In addition to being a fierce competitor, He is passionate about developing fighters. His coaching is focused is on practical, effective techniques tailored for Kickboxing and Muay Thai.
excerpt: Mitch is an active fighter - He's a well rounded striking coach and a PC Kru, teaching practical techniques from Muay Thai, Boxing, and Kyokushin Karate.
metaDescription: Mitch Reed is a striking coach and fighter at Harbinger MMA in Portland, teaching practical striking from Muay Thai, Kyokushin and boxing for MMA.
